blue.text: The enemy column is on the bridge. Pour volleys into its head as it comes off the bridge and hold your ground.
Swing your left wing forward so that the whole battalion fires into the flank of the column on the bridge. Hold the bank.
Charge the head of the enemy column the moment it comes off the bridge onto our bank, then rally behind the 1st Battalion.

red.text: Push on at the bayonet now. Clear the south end of the bridge and form line across the road on the far bank. Hold it at all costs.
Follow the Vanguard over the bridge at the double and deploy on its left on the far bank. Together hold the south end.
As soon as the Vanguard is over, cross the bridge and drive off the enemy horse behind the bridge-end.
